steps.title: Open the Cockpit homepage
steps.narration: Let's start with the live cockpit. This is where you watch real market tape and live charts.
steps.point_out: The cockpit page with the Ticker field, Tape State, Quote, and live candle chart.

steps.title: Watch a symbol and connect live tape
steps.narration: Type a ticker symbol into the Ticker field and click Watch to connect live market data.
steps.point_out: The Tape State showing 'Buyer Control', the Quote panel with real prices, and the live 10-second candle chart.

steps.title: Connect to the tape
steps.narration: Click the Watch button to connect live tape.
steps.point_out: The Tape State should change to 'Buyer Control' and the Quote panel should populate with Bid/Ask prices.

steps.title: Navigate to Structure
steps.narration: Now let's look at the Structure page to examine support and resistance bands.
steps.point_out: The Structure page with the Symbol field, as-of date picker, and the Tradable Map.

steps.title: Load structure for a symbol
steps.narration: Enter a symbol and select an as-of date to analyze its support and resistance levels.
steps.point_out: The Tradable Map table showing quality-scored bands with Class ratings and member counts.

steps.title: Set the analysis date
steps.narration: Pick the date for the historical analysis.

steps.title: Load the structure
steps.narration: Click Load to compute the Tradable Map for this symbol and date.
steps.point_out: The Tradable Map table populated with real quality-scored bands.

steps.title: Navigate to the Desk
steps.narration: Open the Desk page to see the Microscope Readiness panel, the era's first honest inventory of what research data exists.
steps.point_out: The Desk page with all sections including the new Microscope Readiness panel at the bottom.

steps.title: Expand the Microscope Readiness section
steps.narration: Click to expand the Microscope Readiness section and see the corpus inventory — how many symbol-days of tick data exist and whether they meet the research floor.
steps.point_out: The Corpus Totals showing the distinct symbol-days, distinct datasets, and session-equivalents; the Legacy Tick Shards table; the Pilot-Study Floors table showing which floors are met.
